headline: Meta open sources Muse code so anyone can build Muse-powered gadgets
summary: Meta has open-sourced the code behind its Muse AI agent, letting people build their own Muse-powered gadgets, such as an E Ink display or an HDMI stick. The company also built its own smart home device, the Muse Home Link.

claims.statement: Meta open-sourced code that lets people build their own Muse-powered gadgets.
